column1: # Title:    FY 2019 Preliminary Data Table 6 -- Percentages of Children Served in Care
# Agency:   HHS Administration for Children and Families (ACF), Office of Child Care
# Program:  Child Care and Development Fund (CCDF)
# Origin:   ACF-801 case-level administrative records, FY2019
# Published: 2021-05-21   Data as of: 2021-01-29   Page current as of: 2026-06-22
# Retrieved: 2026-09-03 via browser -- acf.gov returns 403 to non-browser clients
# Used for: CCDF floor on informal care (docs/state_data_provenance.tex, sec 2.4).
#           NOT a build input. Floor only -- subsidised children only, and the
#           family copay is unobserved so paid/unpaid cannot be split.
#   - Percentages use "adjusted" numbers: raw state count x pooling factor (ACF-800).
#   - "0%" often means < 0.5%, not zero. Rounding may break the 100% total.
#   - Children in multiple settings counted proportionally by hours in each.
#   - Children with invalid/missing care type, hours or payment -> Invalid/Not Reported.
#   - "-" = not reported. American Samoa and Virgin Islands filed no FY2019 ACF-801.
#   - Months submitted: Alabama 9, Georgia 2, Louisiana 11. All others 12.
#   - Georgia's high Invalid share follows a transition to a new eligibility system.
#   - Colorado, Puerto Rico, Washington have high out-of-range/missing hours+payments.
